items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 133:1
items.html: The ten Sefirot are divided into internal vessels and external vessels. For there are only three internal vessels in the Partzuf, KHB, or the brain, the bones, and the sinews. But the ZON separated from the vessels of the Partzuf in the secret of a garment and a palace. Therefore the two vessels, the flesh and the skin, which are the aspect of ZON, are only incomplete external vessels, and they do not join with the internal vessels, but only surround the internal vessels all around. (Item 107),
